name: Chitral State (1571–1969)
description: A white field with a thin green border, charged with a green emblem of mountains, cypress trees and a crescent and star, with the name 'Chitral' in Urdu, all within a triangular outline pointing to the fly.
history: Flag of the princely state of Chitral, which acceded to Pakistan in 1947.

features.role: mountains, cypresses, crescent and star with 'Chitral' in Urdu
